# P321 native authority originals

These 33 complete issuing responses are the exact originals selected by the reviewed next267 core authority plan. `manifest.json` retains their source URL, release, license and raw SHA-256, including separate product companions for both native genes. No source bytes were trimmed or normalized.

All originals use deterministic gzip storage (level 9, mtime zero, no embedded filename). `storage.json` binds both compressed and decoded bytes. Tests verify both layers and materialize the original logical cache paths in a temporary directory. XML parsing follows the original declared encoding. The source identities do not establish enzyme function, whole ETF cofactor occupancy or singleton assembly stoichiometry.
